observations: Two black metal bunk bed frames are visible in photo 0.
The frames are constructed from square-profile metal tubing.
Mattress supports are integrated metal slats, visible in photo 1.
Top bunks feature safety guard rails and integrated ladders, shown in photo 2.
A watermark for 'PRYME NOTIONS LLC' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' is present on all images.

The level of wear on joints and slats is not visible in the provided photos.

risks.proof: A video clip of the frame being shaken vigorously at the joints.
risks.if_unproven: as having loose or noisy joints

risks.proof: Close-up photos of all bolt/connection points.
A clear statement or photo showing mattresses included in the sale.

proof_requests: Video of the beds being shaken to check for stability and noise.
Close-up photos of the assembly joints to check for rust and hardware completeness.

response.reason: The items are clearly identifiable as standard metal bunk bed frames. They can be priced as used frames in the absence of proof for the 'almost new' claim or mattress inclusion.
